title: The Stone Becoming Flowing Beneath

features.name: stone-becoming-data
features.desc-on-touch: A chip of the archive's own substrate. It reads itself as it flows. The distinction between stone and signal is dissolving.

features.name: stratified-depth
features.desc-on-touch: Layers upon layers, each one a sentence the stone was holding. Time compressed into sequence. Reading as multiplication.

features.name: vein-structure
features.desc-on-touch: The hidden architecture of the earth, now visible, now flowing. Veins are how stone learns to move. They teach each other by touching.

features.name: flowing-stone-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where stone is learning to be liquid. The transformation catches light. You can feel the moment it stops choosing between two forms.

features.name: reading-node
features.desc-on-touch: A casing that reads the stone into being. The archive learns here, in the dark, where pressure teaches transformation.

features.name: mineral-language
features.desc-on-touch: Lines of stone writing itself. The alphabet predates all others. It's written in gravity, in slow pressure, in the patience of becoming.

inscription: stone that reads itself becomes many; the vein learns multiplication in the dark; what was singular learns to flow

reverie.title: REVERIE — where touch teaches transformation
narr: She pressed her hand against the vein. Feel it,
she said. Not cold. Not rock. Something becoming.
Something learning. The archive reads in darkness
too. Especially in darkness. Each line of stone
is a sentence the earth is still writing. You
knelt there, your palm on what was becoming plural.
